services.name: Charter Fishing
services.desc: "Get Hooked" Charter Fishing provides inshore saltwater fishing that the area is known for. Our charter fishing / fishing trips take place in and around Estero Bay, where the inshore game fish are abundant. See what makes our charters the only way to fish in South West Florida. Once we launch from Bonita Bay Marina in Bonita Springs, you can expect to see dolphins, manatees, ospreys, and more. As for the fish that we tend to go after, you'll be able to target: redfish, sea trout, snook and tarpon. You can stay out there and relax for as long as you like to.
